limitations: Top-three production screen is not projected keeper choice.
Actual keepers require future season expectations and league-specific draft position mapping.
The field three_week_yahoo_points is a legacy calendar-week AVERAGE, not a three-week sum.
A zero score counts for the calendar-week average; no game or bye metadata is needed to infer games played.
Last-three-nonzero-game average is a research convenience, not a confirmed games-played metric: an actual played zero-point game would be excluded.
A low recent three-week score does not imply a star is expendable.
